rule: SHRINK-ONLY per-file backlog of pointer-only activation sites in the tracked browser JS (client/ + tools/, vendored lib/ excluded). A site is an element the file CREATES and then wires to click/mousedown without going through a11y.make_activable — i.e. an element a keyboard cannot activate (or, on a native control, a mousedown-only listener, which Enter/Space never fire). Read and enforced by test/unit/client_keyboard_activation_tripwire.test.ts: a file above its number is RED, and so is a file BELOW it that was not re-banked. Lowering a number is the only edit that needs no argument; raising one needs a new one.
